description: This file is a Perl test script using various modules including Test::More and Git::I18N to perform localization and translation-related tests, verifying the functionality of the Git::I18N module and locale behavior.

methods.name: prototype
methods.description: Checks the prototype of functions in the Git::I18N module to ensure they conform to expected function signatures.

methods.name: setlocale
methods.description: Sets the locale for the program, used to test localization behavior in different environment settings.

methods.name: ok
methods.description: Test assertion to pass if the condition is true, used for general testing checks.

methods.name: is_deeply
methods.description: Perl test function to compare complex data structures for deep equality.

methods.name: is
methods.description: Test assertion to check if two scalar values are equal.

methods.name: skip
methods.description: Skips a block of tests based on conditions, used here to skip locale-dependent tests if environment variables are not set.
